query: update files set status = 'available', trashed_at = null, trashed_by_id = null where id in (select distinct on (hash) id from files trashed where id = any($1) and status = 'trashed' and trashed_at > now() - make_interval(days => $2) and not exists (select 1 from files available where available.hash = trashed.hash and available.status = 'available') order by hash, trashed_at desc) returning id, ext
